kids.name: title
kids.chars: SCR-030/fp-reduced-load: load copy; both causes; degraded-2d

kids.name: source
kids.chars: Source: spec §5.1 L414-439, §5 L404 · §0 L76 · state: the frame budget missed (load); insets: zoom and load together, degraded-2d

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Frame: board 01's base grid, 10 bars × 40 rows at 17.6 px, L0 by height (§3 L185), while the frame budget is missed for 3 frames (26 §11; 06 §4.4 rung 2; §5 L404): the L2 look, the display mode without text (QA R6): fill and the 1 px notch, no outline; marks and short labels stay (§4.2 L252; D5; D6).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Badge: the load copy (§5.1 L425) in the corner-badge slot, 8 px in from the plot's left edge and up from the pane's bottom, a 20 px pill with the warning glyph (L429-431; D8).

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Inset 1, both causes: 100 rows of 7.0 px (§3 L197-198), under the 8.5 px down-switch, plus the load: the load copy wins, zooming would not help (§5.1 L426; QA Q10).

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Inset 2, degraded-2d: WebGL2 unavailable: coloured cells without text (26 §11, §3.7) and E11-D02's badge (§5.1 L427).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: D1, D2, D3, D5 (no outline at L2), D6, D7 (the cap on 13:35), D8, D15 ([FP], the legend row), D16; QA R6, Q10 (§1.3 L127); A-2, A-26: 14's 6 px copy and "Reduced detail — colour only" are not used (§5.1 L437-439).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: The footprint is market data, identical in demo and live (§5 L408); this board shows no gated control (the badge is text, not a control, §5.1 L434), so no T2. [Draw] and the rail are E14's. The footprint's T2 controls are on boards 08, 23-25, 31, 43, 45, 51 and 53.

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Tab: toolbar (one stop: [FP], Chart | Table) → legend (footprint row, ⋯) → plot (one roving stop) → right gutter → time axis → cluster (§8.1 L721-724; no chip, strip action or left gutter at rest); the badge is no stop (§5.1 L434). Zoom does not restore text under load (§5.1 L426); Alt+T gives every value (no keymap entry yet, GAP-12). degraded-2d: the same; one mirror for every RenderProfile (26 §12).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: None drawn at rest; a selected level gets the ≥ 2 px level box (§8.1 L740). Cells under the badge stay drawn; the tooltip, the drawer and the mirror carry their values (§5.1 L431-432).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Frame and inset 1: the load copy, polite, once per tier change; it joins the chart region's accessible description, and cursor moves add "footprint at low detail" (§5.1 L422-426, L434-436; §8.2 L749). Inset 2: its badge sentence, polite once per rung change (E11-D02 §10, cited by §5.1 L427).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: No spec keys (E18-D05 keys the copy, §16 L937): the load copy §5.1 L425; E11-D02's "Basic rendering — WebGL unavailable" §5.1 L427; the short label §4.4 L289; the legend row §4.9 L380; the chrome §4.1 L215-227.

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: SYNTHETIC (QA G8): the bench generator, footprint.mjs and bars.mjs, seed '20260928', 40 cells per bar, with §4.1's hand-picked anatomy on 13:25-13:35 (§3 L171-173).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: The same 10 bars in every view, 12:50-13:35 (forming), rows 1.0 USDT, BTC: the window 63,975.0-64,014.0; inset 1 zoomed out to 63,945.0-64,044.0 (§3 L192-198).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: 356 visible cells (≤ 400, §3 L185), under the planning 2,500 (GAP-14): not the cause. The cause is the frame budget, 16.7 ms (26 §3.2; 06 §2 #1: 16.6 ms, footprint text and geometry ≤ 4 ms, 06 §4.3), missed 3 frames running (26 §11); rung 2 hides the cell text (06 §4.4). No per-cell DOM (§9 L776).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: None in the product: the badge follows the engine's LOD event with the footprint tier and its cause, zoom, budget or load (E12-S09; E06-D03 D9; §11 L801). degraded-2d: the startup probe's RenderProfile (26 §3.4).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Rung 4, "Reduced live detail — background pane" (§5.1 L427), is not drawn: §0 L76 names three views (carry pending). Forced colours leave the canvas alone; the badge's words carry the state (§8.3 L766, L771-772). 13:35 has traded §4.1's five levels (POC 64,011.0, L222). The two unfilled cells at 64,009.0 are elided (L224; carry pending), not below weak.

copy_gaps: Rung 4: §5.1 L427's "Reduced live detail — background pane" (`06` §4.4 rung 4, its L92: background panes keep candles and profile only) shares the degraded-2d row, but §0 L76 lists only "load copy; both causes; `degraded-2d`" and §5 L404's trigger omits rung 4; no §0 board draws it (standing gate R4: a state the text names without a frame or a named inset). Not drawn here. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either add "rung 4" to §0 L76 and draw an inset 3 (a 1:1 crop of a background pane: candles only, no footprint, the badge "Reduced live detail — background pane"; about 19 rows fit the space left under inset 2), or state at §5.1 L427 that rung 4 belongs to E11-D02 (its board 09 draws the reduced-detail badge, E11-D02 L21) and needs no E18 frame.

Precedence: §5.1 ranks only zoom against load (L426); it gives none between degraded-2d's badge (L427) and the reduced-detail copies, nor says whether two can show. Inset 2 draws L427's copy alone in the one corner-badge slot (D2 L152: one meaning per slot).

Step size: `26` §11 L633 (and §3.2 L124) steps down one LOD level per 3 missed frames; §5.1 L425's copy says the text is hidden, which is L2 (QA R6, §1.3 L127; `06` §4.4 rung 2, its L90). The frame draws L2; an intermediate L1 step from L0 has no badge copy in the spec. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either a §5.1 sentence "under load the footprint goes to the L2 look in one step (`06` §4.4 rung 2), not one LOD level per 3 frames (`26` §11)", or a badge copy for an L1 load step.

Composition names follow the build notes' `<CMP id> <Name> (composition)` with `15`'s catalogue names (CMP-221 ChartToolbar L2592, CMP-222 ChartTypeToggle L2601, CMP-003 SegmentedControl L69, CMP-075 EnvBadgeLocal L733, CMP-199 ChartLegend L2379, CMP-223 DrawingToolbar L2610, CMP-188 PriceAxis L2220, CMP-189 TimeAxis L2233); the badge is CMP-180 ChartRoot's reduced-detail state (`15` L2091). The kit's builders name them informally.

Inset 1 zooms the price axis out to 100 rows, which turns autoscale off: E11-D02 L44 and §7.1 L254-260 then show the "Price scale locked" badge on the price axis, a Tab stop (§8.1 L724 "lock badge"). It is not drawn: §3 L194's "auto-fit off" raises the same question for every SCR-030 board, and §4.1's sketch draws no badge. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane), base grid: draw the lock badge whenever auto-fit is off, or add a §3 sentence saying the boards leave it out.

Kit behaviour at L2, recorded here: the two cells the §4.1 sketch elides ("..." at 64,009.0 in the 13:25 and 13:30 bars, L224; kit `ELIDED`) carry no value, so the L2 look draws no fill there (kit `_vol`), in the frame and inset 1 (inset 2's crop ends below them); the Notes block says they are not below-weak cells. They take no part in the POC, value area and auction rules (kit `traded_rows`). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane), review/02 finding 10: §4.1 L224 hand-picks the two cells so the sketch rows gain no outline (13:25: bid 235–2,105, ask 21–185; 13:30: bid 68–602, ask 63–557; inside these both POCs stay at 64,011.0), then the boards draw those values.

Window 63,975.0-64,014.0, one row (1.0 USDT) above the base scene's 63,974.0-64,013.0, as boards 01, 02, 20-23 and 28 place it (replaces the kit's 'window' note): §4.1's sketch draws the cap on its own line above 64,013.0 (L219), and D6 / D7 draw the ledge and the cap above the high (L156-157); still 40 rows of 17.6 px (§3 L185). The closed bars' 63,974.0 row lies below the window: its cells are not drawn and their wicks run from 64,013.0 to the pane's bottom edge; POC, value area and flags are computed over every traded row (local clip_to_view(), from gen_28.py / gen_01.py). Inset 1 shows the whole scene (63,945.0-64,044.0); inset 2 the window's bottom 20 rows.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the base scene's 40 rows; the closed bars trade every row (§3 L193), so their wicks run from 64,013.0 down to 63,974.0 (cut at the pane's bottom edge in the frame); 13:35's wick spans its five levels and its body is §4.1's ▌ rows 64,011.0-64,013.0 (L220-222); bodies are filled (their form is E12-D06's, D3 L153) (replaces the kit's 'candles' note).

The 9 closed bars' low ledges (unfinished auction at 63,974.0, both sides traded) lie below the frame's window and are not drawn there or in inset 2 (replaces the kit's 'clip' note); inset 1 draws them. 13:35's cap and its low ledge under 64,009.0, and every bar's high ledge above 64,013.0 (10), draw in the frame and inset 1.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared: `24` §4.2's treat_as_min would flag every bar's high (sell) and low (buy); the §4.1 anatomy draws no such flag (L220-224).
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
